title: Noob Warrior
description: This mod adds different abilities to Minecraft which can be used with mana.
body:
# Noob Warrior

**Noob Warrior** is a lightweight RPG-style ability mod for Minecraft 1.21.5 (26.1.2) that adds a mana system and unlockable combat/support abilities. It requires Fabric Loader >=0.19.3 and Fabric API.

---

## Why Install It?

Vanilla combat is straightforward — left-click to attack, right-click (with a shield) to block. Noob Warrior adds **skill-based mechanics** that give you more options in combat and exploration without overhauling the entire game. Abilities are earned through gameplay, consume a resource (mana), and require timing and awareness to use effectively. It's designed to feel like a natural extension of vanilla.

---

## Mana System

Every player starts with a mana pool of **5**. Key mechanics:

- **Passive regen**: 1 mana per minute
- **Food**: Eating any food gives 0.5–1.5 mana (based on nutrition)
- **Sleep**: Waking from bed refills mana to maximum
- **Max mana**: Permanently expandable by consuming Mana Ore (+5) or Purified Mana (+20)

---

## Abilities

Abilities are permanent unlocks. To obtain one, enchant a book at an enchanting table (the ability enchantments appear randomly). Right-click the enchanted book to consume it and learn the ability.

Cycle between your unlocked abilities with **Ctrl + Scroll Wheel** and activate with **R** (customizable in key bindings).

### Jump
- **Cost**: 0.5 mana
- **Effect**: Launches you 8 blocks forward and 3 blocks upward
- **Restriction**: Can only be used while on the ground
- **Use case**: Quick vertical mobility, escaping danger, reaching high places

### Critical Hit
- **Cost**: 3 mana
- **Effect**: Launches you upward, applies Strength VIII for during the ability
- **Requirement**: Must be holding a sword or axe
- **Restriction**: Can only be activated while airborne
- **Visual**: Orange/yellow border glow appears while active
- **Use case**: Powerful aerial attacks

### Mob Inspector
- **Cost**: 0.1 mana per tick (while looking at a mob)
- **Effect**: Displays the target mob's name, health, attack damage, and active potion effects on its name tag
- **Use case**: Assessing threats, finding weakened enemies, checking ally status

---

## Items

### Mana Ore
- **Recipe**: 4 diamonds (cross pattern) + 1 netherite scrap
- **Effect**: Eating it permanently increases max mana by 5
- **Animation**: Standard eating animation

### Purified Mana
- **Recipe**: 8 diamonds (full ring) + 1 enchanted golden apple
- **Effect**: Right-click instantly consumes and permanently increases max mana by 20
- **Animation**: Custom blue soul-flame particles + totem-style item activation animation
- **Note**: Does not use the eating animation — instant use

### Mana Tome
- **Obtain**: Creative tab
- **Effect**: Right-click opens an info screen listing all abilities with their descriptions and mana costs
- **Navigation**: Arrow keys or page buttons to flip through pages

### Ability Book
- **Obtain**: Enchant a book at an enchanting table
- **Effect**: Right-click consumes the book and permanently grants the contained ability
- **Visual**: Automatically gains a custom book model when it contains an ability enchantment

---

## HUD Elements

- **Selected ability**: Displays the currently selected ability name at the bottom-right of the screen (with a semi-transparent background)
- **Critical Hit overlay**: Orange/yellow border with rounded corners while critical hit mode is active

---

## Commands

All commands require operator privileges:

- `/ability give <player> <ability_id>` — grants an ability
- `/ability remove <player> <ability_id>` — removes an ability
- `/ability list <player>` — lists all abilities a player owns
- `/mana get [player]` — shows current mana
- `/mana set <player> <amount>` — sets mana
- `/mana add <player> <amount>` — adds mana
- `/mana-limit get [player]` — shows max mana
- `/mana-limit set <player> <amount>` — sets max mana
- `/mana-limit add <player> <amount>` — increases max mana

---

## Miscellaneous

- **Multiplayer compatible**: All features work on dedicated servers
- **Creative mode bypass**: Creative players can use abilities without consuming mana
- **Abilities screen**: Accessible from the pause menu — shows owned and all available abilities
- **Fabric API dependency**: Required
